+1 """Quicksort from scratch (iterative, in-place, median-of-three pivot)."""
+2 import json
+3 import os
+4 import time
+5 
+6 
+7 def sort(arr):
+8     """Sort a list in place with quicksort and return it (no sorted()/list.sort())."""
+9     stack = [(0, len(arr) - 1)]
+10     while stack:
+11         lo, hi = stack.pop()
+12         while lo < hi:
+13             # Insertion sort for small partitions
+14             if hi - lo < 16:
+15                 for i in range(lo + 1, hi + 1):
+16                     key = arr[i]
+17                     j = i - 1
+18                     while j >= lo and arr[j] > key:
+19                         arr[j + 1] = arr[j]
+20                         j -= 1
+21                     arr[j + 1] = key
+22                 break
+23             # Median-of-three pivot selection
+24             mid = (lo + hi) // 2
+25             a, b, c = arr[lo], arr[mid], arr[hi]
+26             if a > b:
+27                 a, b = b, a
+28             if b > c:
+29                 b, c = c, b
+30                 if a > b:
+31                     a, b = b, a
+32             pivot = b
+33             # Hoare partition
+34             i, j = lo, hi
+35             while i <= j:
+36                 while arr[i] < pivot:
+37                     i += 1
+38                 while arr[j] > pivot:
+39                     j -= 1
+40                 if i <= j:
+41                     arr[i], arr[j] = arr[j], arr[i]
+42                     i += 1
+43                     j -= 1
+44             # Recurse (via stack) on smaller side, loop on larger side
+45             if j - lo < hi - i:
+46                 stack.append((i, hi))
+47                 hi = j
+48             else:
+49                 stack.append((lo, j))
+50                 lo = i
+51     return arr
